'''Fenix''' was a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Fenix lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] and established a network of contacts, who helped him to find out about everything that went on there. The main place he hanged out was [[Botcha's]], a bar in the planet's factory district. One time while he was there with a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], he was approached by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who asked him for information on the location of the stolen [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[First Light (freighter)|''First Light'']].
